verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents an Alerts feature, webhook-based usage tracking, and an MCP tool for querying sync status and detecting broken connections, showing genuine run-status observability and alerting infrastructure exists. However, the evidence never specifies Slack/email as alert channels, doesn't document per-sync row-count reporting, and lacks detail on log viewing in the dashboard beyond generic mentions. Missing for 10: documented Slack/email alert channel configuration, explicit per-sync row-count metrics, and dashboard log detail/independent corroboration of alerting reliability.
